evidence.title: Inside NVIDIA Halos for Robotics: A Full-Stack Functional Safety System for Physical AI
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 Inside NVIDIA Halos for Robotics: A Full-Stack Functional Safety System for Physical AI Jun 22, 2026 By Suhas Hariharapura Sheshadri , Riccardo Mariani , Samuel Ochoa , Deep Rodge and Sarah Todd Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Halos for Robotics unifies AI compute and safety in a single platform extending the company's autonomous vehicle safety stack to industrial robots, humanoids, and autonomous mobile robots. The foundation combines NVIDIA IGX Thor hardware with built-in functional safety features and NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge to extend the safety chain to sensor edges. Halos OS provides a certified safety operating system with Linux and QNX configurations, including Halos Core for hardware error management and the Edge Safety Link protocol. The NVIDIA Halos Outside-In Safety Blueprint enables robots to use external infrastructure cameras and AI agents for real-time functional safety while maintaining operational throughput. An automated trailer loading reference use case demonstrates dynamic safety muting and reactivation based on worker presence detected by outside-in perception.
